diagnosis: The OpenAI Responses handler correctly linked the Bash search output, built non-empty trajectory context, and identified an adopted bridge.
ContentRouter.compress forwards trajectory_search_relevance to the pure-content path but not to the MIXED path.
_compress_mixed therefore routes its sections without the existing trajectory-search flag, preventing the already-implemented SEARCH relevance override from becoming reachable.
fix_scope: propagate the existing trajectory_search_relevance flag through MIXED routing
do not change bridge extraction, bridge ranking, adoption semantics, force-keep semantics, or relevance scorer
preserve historical call signatures on flag-off paths where practical
epistemic_consequence: U01 is not unseen validation evidence for the corrected implementation.
U01 may be used as a development/regression case for the routing fix.
Any prospective validation of the corrected implementation must use a previously untouched task beginning with the still-locked U02-U12 pool.
